original_test_intent: Read the Assembly resource for one authorized fan member, validate its complete Chassis/Thermal/Fan ancestry and approved physical component identity, and retain redacted inventory evidence without changing cooling controls.
original_method: Resolve the Chassis, Thermal resource and exact fan member link in order, then use trusted curl/jq rather than ipmitool to GET the advertised Assembly child once and validate schema, parent association and BOM mapping.
manual_activity: The thermal/platform owner authorizes the exact fan member, confirms its zone/slot/connector and Assembly representation, supplies the expected fan part/BOM mapping, and approves redaction of serial, asset and location identifiers.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Expected fan slot/zone/connector and BOM association
Component-field redaction and secure evidence policy
safety_requirements: Do not combine guessed ChassisId and FanId
Do not expose credentials or unrestricted fan identifiers
Do not change fan speed, thermal limits or power
agent_execution_scope: Validate exact identity/schema and parent association
Compare fan component/zone/slot/connector data to approved BOM
Export redacted report and no-control-change audit
engineer_actions: Authorize exact fan/link chain and disclosure scope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The guarded nested URI mirrors the source, but ipmitool is unrelated and variable presence does not prove fan membership; `-k`/basic-auth and absent status/schema/zone/BOM checks make it incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using curl/jq with trusted TLS and secret-safe least-privilege authentication, follow each advertised link to one authorized fan Assembly, GET it once, validate exact identity/schema/parent and zone/slot/BOM association, and export only approved redacted fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The nested Fan Assembly GET and 15/10 timing remain; no ChassisId, FanId, zone, slot, connector or component identity is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the Assembly endpoint as physical fan provenance: validate the link ancestry and correlate the component record to the approved zone/slot/connector/BOM without conflating it with instantaneous speed telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative fan membership, physical mapping, schema/BOM comparison and controlled identity disclosure.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Thermal/Fans telemetry establishes current readings/status; this case establishes the selected fan hardware's component identity and parent association, not control response or cooling performance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may expose fan inventory through OEM or alternate resources; missing Assembly on an approved profile must be reported rather than reconstructed from a label. Serial and location data remain sensitive.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent only if it preserves every advertised link and certificate binding, validates exact parent/component identity and does not alter fan controls; ipmitool FRU/SDR data may corroborate but cannot replace this endpoint contract.
expected_evidence: Immutable endpoint, firmware and certificate/trust result
curl/jq/schema-tool and secret-provider versions without secrets
HTTP status/content type and access-controlled raw response hash
Exact Assembly identity/schema and fan parent association

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, path and GET command consistently describe one fan's Assembly child. DeepSeek's ipmitool label and missing schema/mapping are reference-review deficiencies, not Master contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The nested read intent is explicit. Link ancestry, trust, credential, firmware schema, fan physical/BOM map and redaction are concrete prerequisites.

review_improvement: Binds the fan Assembly to an authoritative thermal link chain and adds physical zone/slot/BOM identity plus redaction evidence distinct from live telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: A FanId can be reused or renumbered across firmware and thermal zones, so the selected member must be traced from the intended Chassis/Thermal graph rather than entered independently. Its Assembly response must prove exact parent association before part/BOM comparison; otherwise a healthy fan could be matched to the wrong serviceable module. Speed and health readings belong to telemetry and cannot substitute for component provenance, while inventory serial/location fields require restricted handling.
